items.title: Julius Handy Interview, 1973-05-09
items.q: So I went out there. And I took over from Batiste. And I just went on and did my thing.

ctx.x: Oh, that there's plenty of Dixaland that's not, they're not playing out there? That they're not playing, huh? I've heard this before.

I'm telling it like it is. Because I see lots of times. I go out there and I sit in with a band. I know the Dixaland number. And I see some guy look around at me. I say to myself, now you think I'm making the wrong card, but I'm playing it like it's supposed to be. You understand what I mean? But I had to jump back in with him to make things go along. Now, after the number stopped, Julius, I said, yes. I said, yes, I was wrong. He said, no, you wasn't wrong. He said, you were playing it like it's supposed to be.…
What are you talking about? What was the name?
